placements.why: The content establishes operational rehearsal as a discipline — monthly rollback drills and the principle that unrehearsed rollbacks are not real rollbacks. No existing strata category covers operational practice; this names the organizational tier that holds it.
placements.title: Operational practice as organizational discipline
placements.theme: Operational readiness requires practiced, rehearsed procedures — not just documented ones.

placements.title: Unrehearsed rollback is no rollback
placements.theme: A rollback capability is only real if it has been rehearsed; operational practice must be drilled regularly, not just documented.
placements.why: src-1 directs monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals as operational practice; src-2 articulates the governing principle that an unrehearsed rollback is not a real rollback; src-4 specifies the monthly cadence parameter that operationalizes the principle. Together they establish the narrative that rollback capability requires rehearsal to be genuine — a thematic statement true beyond these specific words.
